description: This file contains Python code for generating template contexts for web interface attributes, including functions for handling getters, setters, attribute properties, and related configurations in a code generation process for web bindings.

methods.name: attribute_context
methods.description: Creates a context dictionary for a given attribute of an interface, determining includes, flags, and properties based on attribute and interface metadata.

methods.name: filter_accessors
methods.description: Filters attributes to include only those suitable for accessor generation, excluding those with certain extended attributes.

methods.name: is_data_attribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute qualifies as a data attribute based on extended attributes.

methods.name: is_lazy_data_attribute
methods.description: Determines if a data attribute is lazy-loaded based on specific conditions.

methods.name: filter_data_attributes
methods.description: Filters attributes to include only data attributes that are not lazy.

methods.name: filter_lazy_data_attributes
methods.description: Filters attributes to include only data attributes that are lazy.

methods.name: filter_origin_trial_enabled
methods.description: Filters attributes enabled by origin trial features.

methods.name: filter_runtime_enabled
methods.description: Filters attributes enabled by runtime features.

methods.name: getter_context
methods.description: Prepares the context for a getter function, including expression generation and handling nullable or special types.

methods.name: getter_expression
methods.description: Constructs the expression string for invoking a getter method.

methods.name: getter_base_name
methods.description: Determines the base name of a getter function based on attribute extended attributes.

methods.name: is_keep_alive_for_gc
methods.description: Decides if an attribute's wrapper should be kept alive for garbage collection based on interface and attribute properties.

methods.name: setter_context
methods.description: Prepares the context for a setter function, including handling special extended attributes and exceptions.

methods.name: setter_expression
methods.description: Constructs the expression string for invoking a setter method.

methods.name: setter_base_name
methods.description: Determines the base name of a setter function based on attribute extended attributes.

methods.name: scoped_content_attribute_name
methods.description: Generates the scoped name for a content attribute, considering interface namespace.

methods.name: is_writable
methods.description: Checks if an attribute is writable based on read-only status and extended attributes.

methods.name: is_data_type_property
methods.description: Determines if an attribute is a data type property, considering constructor and CrossOrigin extended attributes.

methods.name: has_setter
methods.description: Checks if an attribute has a setter, considering data type properties and extended attributes.

methods.name: property_attributes
methods.description: Returns a list of property attributes flags for a given attribute, such as 'DontEnum', 'DontDelete', 'ReadOnly'.

methods.name: has_custom_getter
methods.description: Checks if an attribute has a custom getter based on extended attributes.

methods.name: has_custom_setter
methods.description: Checks if an attribute has a custom setter based on extended attributes.

methods.name: is_constructor_attribute
methods.description: Determines if an attribute is a constructor based on its IDL type name.

methods.name: is_named_constructor_attribute
methods.description: Determines if an attribute is a named constructor based on its IDL type name.

methods.name: update_constructor_attribute_context
methods.description: Updates the context with constructor-specific flags based on attribute and interface properties.
